_how_to_use: Human decisions about registry filer names that could be a natural person.
A name lands here because incidents/filers.py flagged its SHAPE, not because anything
was concluded about it. Until it is decided, its filings are withheld from the published
page AND from incidents/data/state_ag.json — this repository is public, so the record is
To decide, read the pending name from the notice issue or the workflow run log, then:
organisation -> add the name to `organisations`, EXACTLY as the state publishes it.
individual   -> add sha256(name) to `individual_hashes`. The NAME MUST NOT be written
into this file; recording the decision must not create the per-person
record the decision exists to prevent.
Both lists are permanent: a name is decided once and behaves the same way forever.
